mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_day, IFNULL(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND o.status IN () AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY stat_day ORDER BY stat_day

SELECT t.goodsId, t.goodsName, t.goodsImage, t.salesQty, t.salesAmount, g.stock AS stock, g.price AS price, g.sales AS totalSales, c.name AS categoryName FROM ( SELECT i.goods_id AS goodsId, MAX(i.goods_name) AS goodsName, MAX(i.goods_image) AS goodsImage, SUM(i.quantity) AS salesQty, SUM(i.price * i.quantity) AS salesAmount FROM order_item i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND o.status IN () AND o.pay_time >= #{start} AND o.pay_time < #{end} GROUP BY i.goods_id ) t LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = t.goodsId LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.salesQty DESC, t.salesAmount DESC, t.goodsId ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, c.cover AS courseCover, c.start_time AS startTime, c.status AS status, c.total_quota AS totalQuota, c.remain_quota AS remainQuota, COUNT(b.id) AS bookingCount, IFNULL(SUM(b.quota), 0) AS bookingPeople FROM course c LEFT JOIN booking b ON b.course_id = c.id AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.status IN () WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.cover, c.start_time, c.status, c.total_quota, c.remain_quota ORDER BY bookingPeople DESC, bookingCount DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId}) AS waitAudit,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId}) AS passedUnchecked,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN (4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId}) AS checkedCount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM booking b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId}) AS validCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND c.status = 2) AS endedCourseCount,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(b2.quota), 0) FROM booking b2 JOIN course c2 ON c2.id = b2.course_id AND c2.deleted = 0 WHERE b2.deleted = 0 AND b2.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND c2.status = 2 AND b2.status IN (4,5)) AS checkinPeople,
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(b3.quota), 0) FROM booking b3 JOIN course c3 ON c3.id = b3.course_id AND c3.deleted = 0 WHERE b3.deleted = 0 AND b3.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} AND c3.status = 2 AND b3.status = 1) AS absentPeople

SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, c.start_time AS startTime, c.status AS status, c.total_quota AS totalQuota, c.remain_quota AS remainQuota, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN () THEN b.quota ELSE 0 END), 0) AS usedQuota, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.status IN () THEN b.id END) AS bookingCount FROM course c LEFT JOIN booking b ON b.course_id = c.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.craftsman_id = #{craftsmanId} GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.start_time, c.status, c.total_quota, c.remain_quota ORDER BY c.status ASC, c.start_time ASC, c.id ASC
